title: From a realized Cartier Ext class to the normalized arrow equation
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring object, A an ordinary finite commutative ring, N a positive natural killing A, and Y a Noetherian scheme with N invertible on W=diagonalSurface Y. Supply a line family L, a Diagram d over R, a finite realization eW on W, a line isomorphism to geoCartierLine(A,N,hA,W), and a source isomorphism to the direct image of the ordinary constant A on ProjectiveLine Y. If finiteRealizedClass formed from exactly these maps and d.delta is the canonical positive Cartier class, then FiniteCartierArrowEquation holds for exactly these same maps [def-diagonal-finite-arrow-equations]. This is a proved conversion between Ext representatives and derived arrows; it constructs no endpoints and assumes no completed class.

proof.text: Unfold FiniteCartierArrowEquation, finiteCartierArrow and extensionArrow. Unfold the explicit inverse-Ext construction of finiteRealizedClass in the given class equality. Apply Equiv.symm_apply_eq for Ext.homEquiv. Its inverse identity gives exactly the arrow equation.

theorem finiteCartierArrowEquation_of_class
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X) (d : Diagram R Y L)
    (eW : FiniteRealization R A (diagonalSurface Y))
    (line : eW.F.obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (diagonalSurface Y))
    (s : eW.F.obj (source R Y) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
        (geoCartierConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (h : finiteRealizedClass N hA Y eW line s d.delta =
      geoCartierCanonicalClass A N hN hA (diagonalImmersion Y)
        (diagonalImmersion_cartier Y) hW) :
    FiniteCartierArrowEquation R A N hN hA Y hW L d eW line s
